settings.evaluation_seed_policy: Each evaluation episode gets initial phase seed + zero-based episode index, independently of training.
settings.training_seed_policy: Both methods start each 1000-episode worker chunk with the same listed seed; weights, counts, and exploration settings resume from their preceding checkpoint.
settings.execution_order: Serial chunks; method order alternates at each milestone. Each chunk is followed by one frozen-policy check-in. Evaluations never update or overwrite training checkpoints.
settings.progress_measurement: Best orb proximity and furthest x sampled at six-tick decision boundaries and each terminal transition, not every physics tick.

posthoc_diagnostic.reason: The fixed-reward policy passed scheduled check-ins at 4000 through 9000, but both final 10000 policies failed all 30 frozen evaluations. Evaluate the 9000 pair with the identical final evaluation seed list to test earlier-policy reliability.

limits: One paired training replicate; the per-chunk seeds are not independent full training replicates.
One check-in episode per milestone is a diagnostic, not a success-rate estimate.
Final evaluations use different RNG seeds on the same map and spawn; deterministic policies may repeat the same route.
The matched 9000-episode diagnostic was selected after observing final-policy failures; it is not a prespecified primary endpoint or independent best-checkpoint validation.
Best progress is sampled at decision boundaries, so brief between-decision peaks may be missed.
Reward returns have different scales and are not a cross-method performance score.
